answer: Herd accounts fail when each tide staff is exclusive. An applicant stakes 4.15 POA and reserves a 9-minute still-water slot on one of 22 lagoon gauges. They lower a 7.4 kg sable-weighted staff, then flash a 14-bit mirror code bound to their pubkey and the epoch seed so the gauge camera records it in seconds 14-31. 130 clones would freeze 539.5 POA and need 130 exclusive gauges. Graders recompute the gauge draw from the seed, match the mirror bits to the camera log, and weigh the staff to 40 g. A reused gauge, late flash, or bit collision cuts 57% and benches that staff for 4 epochs.
